parameters.query: SELECT u.email, u.full_name, u.id AS user_id, pc.control_id, cd.nist_id, cd.requirement_text, p.name AS program_name, o.slug AS org_slug FROM program_controls pc JOIN programs p ON pc.program_id = p.id JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id JOIN control_definitions cd ON pc.control_definition_id = cd.id LEFT JOIN users u ON pc.assigned_to = u.id WHERE pc.id = '{{ $json.body.program_control_id }}'
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT enabled FROM user_notification_preferences WHERE user_id = '{{ $json.user_id }}' AND category = 'assessment_complete'), true) AS send_email

INSERT INTO email_log (recipient_email, category, subject, reference_id, provider_id) VALUES ('{{ $('Build Email').first().json.to }}', 'assessment_complete', '{{ $('Build Email').first().json.subject }}', '{{ $('Build Email').first().json.program_control_id }}'::uuid, '{{ $json.id }}')
